scope: Read-only review of saved ordinary OPE-v3 core cohorts and local write order results.

core_cohort_review.concurrent_observation: Each response contains one complete old state permitted for that call. No mixed field or record revision appears.
core_cohort_review.checks: Actual request keys, requested fields, exact membership, four generated field values, atom identity, molecule identity, range order, response completeness, receipt counts, ack modes, and file-read totals agree.
core_cohort_review.independence: The review computes generated values and identities from the schema and recipe. It does not rely on all_fields_and_membership_match.

local_write_order_review.repeated_write_result: All ten keys return id and payload last.
local_write_order_review.mixed_write_result: c0 is absent. c1 returns payload after-delete but omits requested id before and after normal reopen.
local_write_order_review.clock_observability_limit: Query field metadata contains atom and molecule identities and source details. It exposes no author time or logical counter, so this review cannot compare field clocks with receipt revisions.

session_evidence: Saved receipts show five default native starts with cloud off and five clean exit codes without forced stop. The supported cleanup receipt confirms root removal; current sessions.jsonl is unavailable.
failed_earlier_attempts: Malformed-request runs and the v2 observer abort are retained as failed attempts. They do not count as focused passes.
repair_status: Source repair is separate from this saved candidate. A new compiled candidate and new ordinary results are required before release.
